verdict.rationale: Jina Reader's search endpoint (s.jina.ai) explicitly searches the web, fetches the top 5 results, visits each URL, and applies the Reader converter to return full LLM-ready page content rather than just snippets/links, with query examples and site-filtering support documented first-party.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the search endpoint's output quality and no clarity on rate limits/reliability at scale.
